About the NightCAP Ride (Cyclists Against Patriarchy) group ride

A social ride for women, trans, non-binary and queer riders. The group calls it a ride for anyone but cis dudes. The meeting spot moves around Brooklyn and is posted on Instagram each week. The ride pauses for winter.
